label: Grant Blueprint Permission
mcp_tool_description: Give a group DEPLOY (default) or MANAGE permission on a blueprint, the same as adding it on the blueprint's Permissions tab. Use it right after syncing a blueprint from a Source Control Repository: the importer keeps only the groups named in the metadata and repo exports name none, so a sync of a blueprint whose any_group_can_deploy is false removes every group's deploy and manage permission and fetch_orderable_groups turns empty. Give the blueprint's global id (BP-...) or exact name and the group's global id (GRP-...) or exact name. Idempotent. Returns the groups that can deploy and manage the blueprint afterwards. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
